board.summary: Bad Left Hook's current Aug. 29 slate remains the actionable pool. A fresh market sweep found no PLAY. Cameron remains the strongest thesis but +220 is still short of the +240 entry; the best three-way market implies roughly +240 no-vig before any independent handicap edge. Hrgovic at +700 and Berinchyk at +450 remain price watches just below their +750 and +500 triggers. Martinez's moneyline is too expensive and a defensible KO/TKO price is still not verified.

cards.movement: BEST PRICE HOLDS NEAR +220 · TARGET STILL NOT REACHED
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook frames this as an elite, competitive unification and the matchup remains closer than the favorite-heavy price suggests. The current best +220 implies 31.3%; the best three-way market normalizes to roughly 29.4% for Cameron, about +240 fair. The independent thesis needs the extra cushion at +240 or better before upgrading to PLAY.
cards.priceNote: BEST WEB PRICE +220 · NO-VIG MARKET ~+240 · TARGET DISCIPLINE

cards.market: MAYER vs CAMERON · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: METHOD PRICE STILL +370 · NO IMPROVEMENT TO ENTRY BAND
cards.rationale: The ten-round, two-minute-round title format and both fighters' recent decision-heavy profiles keep the decision angle viable, but +370 still does not compensate enough for method-market hold and outcome variance. Keep the angle, reject the current quote, and require roughly +450 or better.
cards.priceNote: CURRENT METHOD +370 · TARGET +450 · ORIGINAL A IDEA REMAINS DOWNGRADED

cards.movement: BEST MARKET +700 · US BOOKS MOSTLY +450 TO +600
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook's case for Hrgovic is still experience, durability and a specific counter-punching plan against Itauma. The best current three-way quote of +700 normalizes to about +708 fair, so the market itself is not giving an edge yet. A +750 or better number would finally clear the market-derived threshold and justify a second pass.
cards.priceNote: LINE SHOP REQUIRED · BEST +700 · MARKET NO-VIG ~+708

cards.market: MARTINEZ vs PLANTIC · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: MARTINEZ ML RANGES ABOUT -600 TO -715 · METHOD PRICE STILL MISSING
cards.rationale: Martinez remains the clearly favored side and carries an 80% career knockout rate, but Plantic is unbeaten and the straight moneyline is heavily taxed. The only potentially useful Martinez route remains a stoppage prop at a defensible price; without a verified method quote there is no play.
cards.sourceLabel: BAD LEFT HOOK + PROBOX + MARKET SWEEP
cards.priceNote: NO VERIFIED KO/TKO QUOTE · MONEYLINE REJECTED

cards.movement: BEST +450 · MANY BOOKS SHORTER AT +350 TO +400
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook still presents Berinchyk as a legitimate former champion rather than a token opponent, but age, inactivity and his last loss keep the upset thesis price-sensitive. The current best +450 normalizes to roughly +479 fair in the three-way market; +500 or better is the minimum number that creates a modest market-derived cushion.

Noakes is younger, more active and the likelier winner, but the market already charges a premium for those advantages. At roughly -450 to -500 there is no useful edge after removing hold, so the favorite is investigated and rejected.

cards.movement: BOOK DISAGREEMENT REMAINS · EVEN BEST FAVORITE PRICE IS EXPENSIVE
cards.rationale: Martinez deserves favoritism, but current listings still range from roughly -600 to -715 while Plantic can be found around +450. That spread shows meaningful hold and disagreement. The moneyline does not offer a defensible margin, so only a properly priced method market remains of interest.
